question: Within a radius of 180 kilometers, where can I locate restaurant on the journey from Captain Mike's Fun Park, Bridgman, MI to McCormick Bridgehouse & Chicago River Museum, Chicago, IL?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-86.576965 41.919871)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.624686 41.888495)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-86.576965 41.919871)',4326)::geography, 180000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-86.576965 41.919871)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
